intervals.note: Start: 'Founded in 1997' (Academia Sinica news item); the 2016 overview dates the research programme to 1996 and its conceptual design to 1997. Open end: the 2026 TEXONO paper says the programme at KSNL will be continued with the RECODE project at the Sanmen Reactor Neutrino Laboratory in China.

summary.plain: The Taiwan-led collaboration, with partners in China, India and Turkey, that runs particle detectors at the Kuo-Sheng nuclear power plant in Taiwan to study neutrinos and search for very light dark matter. It was also a founding partner of China's CDEX dark matter programme.
summary.technical: TEXONO (Taiwan EXperiment On NeutrinO) Collaboration, led by the Institute of Physics, Academia Sinica (Taipei); founding partners listed in the 2016 overview: Academia Sinica, INER, Taipower Nuclear Station II, National Taiwan University and National Tsing Hua University (Taiwan), IHEP, CIAE and Nanjing University (China), University of Maryland (USA); later partners include Banaras Hindu University (India) and METU and Dokuz Eylul University (Turkey). No roster or member count is published in the sources read.
